cues.zh: 于是，
cues.en: and so,

cues.zh: 这在某种意义上是马克思主义思想中的隐含内容，因为，当然，
cues.en: and that is implicit in some sense in Marxist thinking because, of course,

cues.zh: 马克思认为，在资本主义社会中，资本会越来越集中在少数人手中。
cues.en: Marx believed that in a capitalist society capital would accumulate in the hands of fewer and fewer people.

cues.zh: 而这实际上符合层级组织的本质。
cues.en: And that actually is in keeping with the nature of hierarchical organizations.

cues.zh: 那么，问题并不在于
cues.en: Now, the problem with that isn't so much the fact of

cues.zh: 所以，那种指责说这是斗争动机的永恒形式，是有一定准确性的
cues.en: so there's accuracy in the accusation that that is a eternal form of motivation for struggle

cues.zh: 但问题在于低估了问题的严重性
cues.en: but it's an underestimation of the seriousness of the problem

cues.zh: 因为它把问题归因于人类社会的结构，而不是更深层的现实
cues.en: because it attributes it to the structure of human societies rather than the deeper reality

cues.zh: 即层级结构本身的存在，
cues.en: of the existence of hierarchical structures per se,

cues.zh: 而层级结构在很大程度上也刻画了动物王国，显然不只是人类的建构。
cues.en: which as they also characterize the animal kingdom to a large degree are clearly not only human constructions.

cues.zh: 人类之间存在等级竞争这一观点，
cues.en: And the idea that there's hierarchical cometeition among human beings,

cues.zh: 至少从旧石器时代起，就有证据支持。
cues.en: there's evidence for that that goes back at least to the Paleolithic times.

cues.zh: 所以接下来要面对的问题是，
cues.en: And so that's the next problem, it's that, well,

cues.zh: 这种古老的等级结构显然不能归咎于资本主义，
cues.en: this ancient problem of hierarchical structure is clearly not attributable to capitalism

cues.zh: 因为在人类历史上，资本主义出现之前，它早已存在，
cues.en: because it existed long in human history before capitalism existed

cues.zh: 甚至在人类历史本身出现之前，它就已经存在了。
cues.en: and then it predated human history itself.

cues.zh: 那么问题来了：既然这是个更深层次的问题，
cues.en: So the question then arises, why would you necessarily, at least implicitly,

cues.zh: 为什么你必然会——至少是隐含地——把阶级斗争和资本主义联系起来？
cues.en: link the class struggle with capitalism given that it's a far deeper problem?

cues.zh: 还有，你得明白，这对左派来说也是个更深层次的问题，
cues.en: And now, it's also, you've gotta understand that this is a deeper problem for people on the left,

cues.zh: 不只是右派的问题。
cues.en: not just for people on the right.

cues.zh: 等级结构确实会剥夺底层群体的权益，
cues.en: It is the case that hierarchical structures dispossess those people who are at the bottom

cues.zh: 也会剥夺底层生物的权益，比如动物。
cues.en: those creatures who are at the bottom, speaking, say of animals.

cues.zh: -- 但那些处于底层的人，面临着一个根本性的生存问题。
cues.en: -- but those people who are at the bottom, and that is a fundamental existential problem.

cues.zh: 但马克思似乎没考虑到另一件事：
cues.en: But the other thing that Marx didn't seem to take into account is that

cues.zh: 人类苦苦挣扎的原因，远不止阶级斗争。
cues.en: there are far more reasons that human beings struggle than their economic class struggle

cues.zh: 即使把层级观念也纳入其中，这样想会更全面。
cues.en: even if you build the hierarchical idea into that, which is a more comprehensive way of thinking about it.

cues.zh: 人类也在与自己抗争，与内心的恶意抗争，
cues.en: Human beings struggle with themselves, with the malevolence that's inside themselves,

cues.zh: 与自己可能犯下的恶行抗争，也在与内心持续发生的精神和心理斗争抗争，
cues.en: with the evil that they're capable of doing, with the spiritual and psychological warfare that goes on within them,

cues.zh: 而且我们始终也在与自然对抗，但这一点在马克思的论述中似乎从未出现。
cues.en: and we're also actually always at odds with nature, and this never seems to show up in Marx.

cues.zh: 马克思主义整体上也没提到这一点，仿佛自然根本不存在。
cues.en: And it doesn't show up in Marxism in general. It's as if nature doesn't exist.

cues.zh: 在我看来，首要的冲突，或者说一个主要的冲突
cues.en: The primary conflict, as far as I'm concerned, or a primary conflict

cues.zh: 是人类在残酷严苛的自然世界中为生存而挣扎。
cues.en: that human beings engage in is the struggle for life in a cruel and harsh natural world.

cues.zh: 而在马克思主义的领域里，这仿佛根本不存在。
cues.en: And it's as if that doesn't exist in the Marxist domain.

cues.zh: “如果人类有问题，那是因为有阶级斗争，本质上是经济问题”
cues.en: "If human beings have a problem it's because there's a class struggle, it's essentially economic"

cues.zh: 这就好像，不对！
cues.en: it's like, no!

cues.zh: 人类有问题，是因为我们生来就饥饿而孤独
cues.en: Human beings have problems because we come into the life starving and lonesome

cues.zh: 我们必须不断解决这个问题，
cues.en: and we have to solve that problem continually,

cues.zh: 而我们做出社会安排，至少部分是为了缓解这一点。
cues.en: and we make our social arrangements, at least in part, to ameliorate that.

cues.zh: 同时，偶尔也会加剧它。
cues.en: As well as to, well, upon occasion exacerbate it.

cues.zh: 所以《共产党宣言》里也几乎没有认识到
cues.en: And so there's also very little understanding in the Communist Manifesto

cues.zh: 人类所组建的任何等级制组织，可能都有积极的一面。
cues.en: that any of the hierarchical organizations that human beings have put together might have a positive element.

cues.zh: 这绝对是场大灾难，因为层级结构实际上是解决复杂社会问题所必需的，
cues.en: And that's an absolute catastrophe because hierarchical structures are actually necessary to solve complicated social problems,

cues.zh: 我们必须以某种方式组织起来，
cues.en: we have to organize ourselves in some manner,

cues.zh: 而且你得承认对手也有道理，事实确实是层级结构会剥夺一些人的权益
cues.en: and you have to give the devil his due, and so it is the case that hierarchies dispossess people

cues.zh: 这是个很大的问题。这是不平等的根本问题。
cues.en: and that's a big problem. That's the fundamental problem of inequality.

cues.zh: 但同样真实的是，层级结构恰好是一种非常高效的资源分配方式
cues.en: But it's also the case that hierarchies happen to be a very efficient way of distributing resources

cues.zh: 最后还有一点，人类的层级结构从根本上并不建立在权力之上。
cues.en: and it's finally the case that human hierarchies are not fundamentally predicated on power.

cues.zh: 我要说，关于这一点的生物学和人类学数据非常清楚。
cues.en: And I would say the biological/anthropological data on that are crystal clear.

cues.zh: 在人类社会中，你不能主要靠剥削他人来爬上一个可靠的权威位置。
cues.en: You don't rise to a position of authority that's reliable in a human society primarily by exploiting other people.

cues.zh: 这是一种非常不稳定的获取权力的方式，所以——
cues.en: It's a very unstable means of obtaining power, so --

cues.zh: 所以这是个问题。
cues.en: so that's a problem.

cues.zh: 那些笑的人可能会那样做。
cues.en: Well, the people who laugh might do it that way.
